content.text: Rajasthan Ayush Counselling is conducted by the UG/PG Ayush Counselling Board, Govt. of Rajasthan , for admission to Ayush Courses: BAMS/BNYS/BUMS/BSMS/BHMS. The primary criterion for admission to the Ayush courses is the NEET-UG qualification. Seats are offered to all the Ayush colleges in the state, recognized by the NCISM and NCH under different quotas such as State Quota, All India Quota, and NRI Quota.
The NEET-UG 2025 examination was held on 4 May 2025, and the results were published on 14 June 2025. Rajasthan Ayush Counselling dates have not yet been officially published by the authorities.
This article will provide detailed insight into the Rajasthan Ayush Counselling 2025, including the counselling process, fees, cutoff, and more.

sections.heading: Rajasthan Ayush Counselling Overview

content.text: Rajasthan NEET Ayush UG/PG Counselling Board is in charge of conducting the UG counselling for Ayurveda, Naturopathy, Unani, Homeopathy, & Siddha courses. Candidates must register with the Rajasthan Ayush Counselling 2025 official website at rajugpgayushcounselling.in to apply to the Ayush colleges in Rajasthan. NEET-UG qualification of the current year is the mandatory requirement for participating in the counselling. BNYS is the only Ayush course that does not require NEET qualification for admission.

Rajasthan has 18 BAMS colleges , 12 BHMS colleges, 2 BUMS colleges, and 15 BNYS colleges participating in the state counselling. The state offers admission under the State Quota, All India Quota (AIQ), and NRI Quota. The 85% seats of the state are offered to the domicile students of Rajasthan under the state quota . The rest 15% seats are open to non-domicile students/ students from other states under the All India Quota(AIQ) for admission to private Ayush institutions. The 15% AIQ seats counselling for government colleges is conducted by the AACCC.

content.text: Rajasthan State Ayush Counselling offers seats in Ayush Colleges under different quotas: the State Quota, All India Quota (AIQ), and the NRI quota.

sections.heading: Rajasthan Ayush Counselling Process- State Quota
Round 1

items: Registration: The candidates must register with the Rajasthan Ayush Counselling official website at rajugpgayushcounselling.in and submit the application form along with the fee payment. The relevant documents should be uploaded to the website to complete the application.
Publication of Provisional List for Verification

Document Verification: Document verification is conducted by the Counselling Board for PwD, Defence Para-military, and NRI candidates. The candidates must submit the original documents for verification.
Publication of Provisional Merit List

Choice Filling & Locking: Candidates can fill in the choice of colleges according to their preferences and lock their choices. It is mandatory to pay INR 25,000/- counseling fees before choice filling. The fees paid will be considered part of the tuition fee later when joining the college.
Publication of First Round of Allotment Result: Allotment results are published based on the NEET scores, reservation policy, and choice of colleges.
Downloading of Allotment Letter: Candidates must log in to the Raj Ayush official portal and download the Provisional Allotment Letter.
Reporting cum Joining Allotted College: The candidates must report to the allotted college with original documents and complete the admission formalities, along with fee payment.

Registration and Fee payment: The candidates newly registering must submit the application form, upload documents and make payment of fees. The candidates already registered in the Round 1 do not register again.

Choice Filling and Locking: All the candidates, including previously registered candidates can fill in the choice of colleges. It is mandatory to pay INR 25,000/- counseling fees before choice filling. The fees paid will be considered part of the tuition fee later when joining the college.
Publication of Seat Allotment Result: Allotment results are published based on the NEET scores, reservation policy, and choice of colleges.
Downloading of Allotment Letter: Candidates must log in to the Raj Ayush official portal and download the Provisional Allotment Letter.

sections.heading: Rajasthan Ayush Counselling Process- All India Quota(AIQ)

content.text: Registration and Fee Payment: The candidates must register with the official website of AACCC at aaccc.gov.in . Upload the necessary documents and make the fee payment.
Choice Filling/Locking: Candidates can fill in the choice of colleges and state according to their preference, and later lock their choices.
Seat Allotment: Seats are allotted based on the NEET ranks, the seat matrix in the colleges, the choice of colleges, and the reservation criteria.
Publication of Provisional Allotement Letter: The provisional allotment letter is published on the official website of the college. Download the allotment letter for further admission process.
Physical Reporting to College: Candidates must report to the allotted college with the relevant documents and complete the admission procedure, including fee payment.
AIQ Counselling is conducted in 4 rounds, including Round 1/Round 2/ Mop-up Round/ Stray Vacancy Round. Check out the article on AACCC Ayush Counselling to learn more.

content.text: Rajasthan NEET Ayush UG/PG Counselling Board conducts the Rajasthan Ayush Counselling 2025 for admission to Ayurveda, Unani, Homeopathy, and Siddha UG Ayush Colleges in Rajasthan for BAMS/BUMS/BHMS/BNYS courses. The admission to the courses is solely based on the NEET ranks. The Rajasthan State Ayush Counselling is offered under the State Quota of 85% seats reserved for the domicile students of Rajasthan, All India Quota of 15% to private institutions in Rajasthan for non-domicile students, and NRI quota. The All India Quota seats of 15% to the government institutions are handled by the AACCC.
